text:
maya: hey @docs-team — quick heads-up: found a couple issues in console observability docs (dashboard cost breakdown + tracing hook samples). opening a small PR to patch anchors and snippet params. pinging for review.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4213 (maya) :robot_face:

kevin: can you list the broken anchors? i'd like to batch-fix them across the console pages.

maya: main ones:
- /console/metrics#cost-breakdown -> anchor renamed to #cost-aggregation
- /console/tracing#sampling -> now #span-sampling
- old JS snippet uses `traceKey` (deprecated) should be `spanKey`

sam: :eyes: paste old vs new snippet so i can update go/python as well.

maya: Old JS snippet:
```
// legacy
const opts = { traceKey: 'trace-id', sampleRate: 0.1 };
redwood.observability.attachTracing(opts);
```

New JS snippet:
```
// new
const opts = { spanKey: 'x-rw-span', spanSampling: 0.1 };
redwood.observability.attachTracing(opts);
```

olivia: fyi the dashboard cost widget's example image also references the old anchor; recommend adding redirect anchors in the docs site to avoid 404s.

kevin: i'll take the anchors + redirect rules (i'll open infra ticket). sam/olivia — can you sync on snippet API changes? maybe add a migration note in the v2->v3 changelog.

sam: yep i'll update go/python and add a tiny test snippet in examples/observability that the CI can run.

olivia: i'll update the dashboard doc and replace the image alt links. adding checklist to PR comments.

maya: thanks all — PR is small, leaving it as draft until snippets and redirect rules are ready. tagging @kevin @sam @olivia for review. :white_check_mark:
